Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · shell (1): reports and custom pages get the common page header, and every page has a fixed top-right button group (comments, edit app, AI, help); phase 1 of topic #36107, to go first → p2 as set by the coordinator · size M.

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T15:05Z · area b1-SH (epic #36107 phase 1; the maintainer took the epic for this seat on its decision card, 「接，先派 #36111」).
Area: b1-SH
Session: `session_01L6bhgVcCRGjxwhDjrRVYsY` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-k8r3np
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: app-shell `layout/PageHeader.tsx`, `layout/AppHeader.tsx` (the help menu and the edit-app button move out into shared components, the top bar uses the same code), a new page-actions group and its internal context provided by `ConsoleLayout`, `views/ReportView.tsx`, `views/AppReportIndexView.tsx`, `views/PageView.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx` (near the page frame only), the interface-mode list page header; tests (the three PageView edit-entry tests move to the group), changeset.
Container & model: `M/L`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no (expected: no package-root export, no i18n key, no `components` prop; re-measured on built declarations before push)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, read on main `db9e34ad`, file `build-seat1/36111/premise.md` in the project folder): holds. The help menu has five items, not three (this app's docs when a doc exists, all docs, keyboard shortcuts, online docs, about).
Basis: card #36111; epic #36107 (fig. 45, the maintainer's words).
Scope, the seat's reading: reports get the shared page header. The button group (comments slot, edit app, AI, help) is one component behind an app-shell context, default OFF while the top bar exists; tests mount the provider, and browser evidence uses a guarded localStorage switch that #36112 removes when it turns the default on. Drawn once per page (inner headers turn it off), only inside the app shell, never at phone width. Edit app: a text label with a non-pencil icon, builders only, icon-only under 1024, same target as the top-bar pencil; the read-only package's eye form carries over. On the record page the group sits at the right end of the navigation row, left of ✕, through `RecordTopBar`'s existing `frame` slot. The comments icon from #36075 stays where #36114 puts it in this PR; it joins the group's first position when #36112 turns the group on (fig. 45 and the card's order). Phones are unchanged (epic #36107: 「手机端不动」), so the custom page's floating edit button stays at phone width.
Open, to the maintainer after fable review: custom pages that draw their own title (an authored `page:header`, an html page's hero, the interface-mode page's own h1) would show the title twice under the card's literal text. The thread builds option C of its premise (add the shared header only where the page has none; otherwise place the group in the host slot `PageHeaderTrailingContext`; the interface-mode page's own row becomes the shared header) until the answer.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: #36112 and #36113 wait for this card. Overlap: #36114 and #35890 (`RecordDetailView.tsx`), #36047 slice 2 (report title type size). `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. L1 at L1-c. The PR carries `Fixes #36111`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T15:29Z · #36111: the header on custom pages (reviewed by fable first)

At 2026-11-21T15:29Z the maintainer picked option A on the seat's decision card, "the shared header on every custom page, the author's content untouched": every custom page gets the same shared page header as dashboards (the page name on the left, the top-right button group on the right), so the group sits in one place on every page. The page name the renderer draws by itself when a page has no titled `page:header` folds into that header and is no longer drawn twice (the dashboard precedent). A `page:header` the author wrote is drawn as before; when its title equals the page name, the name shows twice, which is accepted. The interface-mode page's own row is replaced by the shared header (it is drawn by the platform from page config, so nothing is lost). html and react pages get the shared header too. This replaces the thread's earlier option C (group in the host slot inside the content), which would have put the group lower and inset on some pages and left no place for #36112's sidebar expand button. In this PR the two showcase pages whose authored title equals the page name (my-work, project-workspace) drop their own title line; hotcrm's sales home gets a small card. Clause-② is re-measured on built declarations before push, since turning off the renderer's own title may touch `@object-ui/components`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim amendment · 2026-11-21T15:41Z · #36111, claim 7064613161, PR #36131

Clause-②: yes (widening). The thread measured it on the built dist of the final diff. `@object-ui/components` gains one new root export, `PageTitleHostContext`. The renderer needs it to drop its own automatic page-name title wherever the shell draws the shared header, which is what ruling 7064921354 picked (option 1: the shared header goes on every custom page and the author's content is left alone). Nothing is removed. The seat runs the declaration-face L2 on the green head. L1 is still L1-c.

Scope, as built under the ruling: the platform never hides a `page:header` the author wrote. Two in-repo showcase pages, my-work and project-workspace, wrote a `page:header` whose title is the same as the page name, so the page name would show twice. This PR removes those two titles by hand, as the pages' author. The hotcrm sales home has the same duplicate and gets its own small card. Everything else in the claim stands.
